auditCorrections.reason: The initial boundary notes conflated the legacy shape.html/app.js amplitude editor with integrated shapes.html/combo-app.js. Direct source re-audit found only the fixed directed corner envelope in combo-app.js. Both requirements are retained and labelled separately; no capability is deleted or declared approved away.
